Interface SuspendableContainerResponseContext

All Superinterfaces:
jakarta.ws.rs.container.ContainerResponseContext
All Known Implementing Classes:
ContainerResponseContextImpl
@Deprecated(forRemoval=true, since="8.0") public interface SuspendableContainerResponseContext extends jakarta.ws.rs.container.ContainerResponseContext
Deprecated, for removal: This API element is subject to removal in a future version.
resuming a suspended filter chain may continue execution on a different thread than the one that suspended it. CDI contexts are bound to a specific thread, so CDI may not behave as expected after such a resumption: a @RequestScoped, @SessionScoped, or @ConversationScoped bean may fail to resolve, or resolve to a different instance than expected, regardless of what scope the matched resource itself uses. @ApplicationScoped and @Dependent beans are unaffected. This is consistent with the Jakarta Concurrency specification's own guidance against relying on those same CDI scopes surviving an asynchronous task boundary, and reliably fixing it is not something this module can do in a CDI-implementation-agnostic way. Suspending the filter chain itself is deprecated for removal; asynchronous processing in resource methods via AsyncResponse/CompletionStage is not deprecated and remains fully supported as a mechanism, but is equally susceptible to this same caveat - code that doesn't reference any CDI bean after dispatching to another thread is unaffected, but code that does is not guaranteed to work.
Suspendable response context, which allows the users to suspend execution of the filter chain until it is resumed normally, or abnormally with a Throwable.

  • Method Details

    • suspend

      void suspend()
      Deprecated, for removal: This API element is subject to removal in a future version.
      Suspends the current response. This makes the current request asynchronous. No further response filter is executed until this response is resumed. No reply is going to be sent to the client until this response is resumed either with resume() or aborted with resume(Throwable) or ResponseContainerRequestContext.abortWith(jakarta.ws.rs.core.Response).

    • resume

      void resume(Throwable t)
      Deprecated, for removal: This API element is subject to removal in a future version.
      Aborts the current response with the given exception. This behaves as if the request filter threw this exception synchronously, which means that the exception will not be mapped by exception mappers, the response filters will stop running, and the async response callbacks will be called with this exception.
      Parameters:
      t - the exception to send back to the client, as an internal server error.
